      School Study Hub
      
  
      Use CodeWorld like a coding class: choose a school-style track, follow a daily study plan, practice, review mistakes, and use trusted Python references when you get stuck.
      
  
      
    
      Choose your learning track
      This does not lock content. It only changes the recommended pace and lesson mix.
      
    
      Course skills
      Problem solvingAlgorithmsVariablesConditionsLoopsFunctionsDataFilesAPIsGUI / UIDebuggingProjects
      Goal: understand what code does, predict results, build programs, explain your choices, and debug errors instead of only copying answers.
      
  
      
  
      
    
      Daily Study Plan
      Pick a study time and press MAKE TODAY'S PLAN.
      
    
      Focus Timer
      25:00
      Use one focus block, then take a normal break away from the screen.
      
    
      Review Mode
      Open a random completed lesson and explain it from memory before looking at the example.
      
    
      Challenge Lab
      Get a short school-style coding prompt from the offline challenge bank.
      Press NEW CHALLENGE when you want an extra practice problem.
      
    
      Study Checklist
      Before marking a lesson complete:
      □ I can explain the idea.
      □ I can type a small example myself.
      □ I can predict its output.
      □ I can fix one mistake.
      □ I know where this idea is useful.
      
  
      
  
      Useful Python Resources
      
  
      Open these when you want a real reference outside CodeWorld.
      
  
      
    Official Python Tutorial ↗Python's own beginner-friendly tutorial and language guide.
    Python Standard Library ↗Look up built-in modules such as math, random, json, pathlib, datetime, and more.
    Python Language Reference ↗Precise reference for Python syntax and language behavior.
    PEP 8 Style Guide ↗Learn common Python formatting and naming conventions.
    tkinter GUI Docs ↗Reference for making desktop interfaces with Python's standard GUI toolkit.
    Installing Packages ↗Learn what pip and packages are and how Python projects add libraries.
  
      
  
      ASMR Coding Sounds
      Turn on ASMR at the top. CodeWorld generates quiet keyboard taps, deeper Enter-key thocks, soft button clicks, a tiny success chime, and a gentle error tone using your browser's audio engine. No audio files or downloads are needed.
      Browsers require you to tap/click once before sound can start. Volume is saved on this device.
